identity.real_world_identity_notes: Mitsubishi Lancer prepared for the Brazilian Lancer Cup one-make series in RS specification, with a 2.0-litre 4B11T MIVEC turbo of about 301 hp at some 1,490 kg and six gears through a sequential stick.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behaviour was directly observed in a guided drive in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: automatic cut on upshifts, no automatic blip, and a clutch needed to pull away, so the driver supplies the downshift blip.
The RS and the R share the Lancer Cup class and are entirely different to drive. Nothing is inherited between them.
This class reports a single configuration; the selection screen offers no aero package and only the plain identity has been observed.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.mitsubishi-lancer-rs.20260816t042131351z-525d7864 by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Simulator behaviour was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is supported by registered sources.

claims.basis: A registered reference establishes the Lancer RS and its gearbox, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
The reference gives six gears through a sequential stick, and the live drive selected six gears through a sequential stick with automatic cut and no automatic blip.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.
